def f(g,bg):
    # bg = most common color; mask = other color cells
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mx=[x!=bg for x in [v for r in g for v in r]]
    rs=[i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    cs=[j for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if g[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=2  # fill interior

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mx=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    rs=[i for i,j in mx]; cs=[j for i,j in mx]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # border columns fill
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in (c0,c1):
            if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=2
    # rows with markers: fill between first and last marker
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        mk=[j for j,x in enumerate(out[i]) if x!=bg]
        if mk:
            mn,mxv=min(mk),max(mk)
            for j in range(mn,mxv+1):
                if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=2
    return out
# verify against demo
din=G['Demo pair 1 input']; dout=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print('demo match:', f(din)==dout)
pred=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(pred))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter as C2
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    p=[(i,j) for i in range(len(do_)) for j in range(len(do_[0])) if do_[i][j]==2 and di[i][j]==bgv]
    print(k,'markers:',mk)
    print('  painted:',p)
